purpose: First UI concept mockups; images are not implementation evidence

prompts.lobby:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity PC FPS game UI visual proposal, one flat 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or larger same aspect ratio. A coherent original industrial operations terminal, inspired by the restrained typographic hierarchy, modular graphic design and industrial information systems of Arknights and Arknights Endfield, but using only this project's identity "MCP / FPS". No copied franchise logos, characters or exact compositions. Palette: charcoal #171B1E, panel #272D31, light warm-gray #E4E5DF, white #F1F2ED, secondary #B8BFBE, restrained industrial yellow #E5C641, red only for danger. Crisp Chinese sans serif typography, tabular numbers, straight-edged rectangles, rare small chamfers, carefully aligned fine rules, generous clear hierarchy. No holograms, glowing neon, rounded mobile cards, gratuitous tiny text or illegible fake paragraphs. All UI weapon illustrations are clean monochrome simplified silhouettes or line drawings, never detailed rendered product weapons. Chinese is the main functional language; short English identifiers are only secondary. Render the given labels exactly and legibly. Small unobtrusive bottom-edge label "视觉样稿 · 非实机画面". This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of an implemented game.
Screen: MAIN LOBBY, a premium quiet industrial control console. Full charcoal background with a very subtle large grid, not a full background scene. Top left small "MCP / FPS", page title "行动终端" with secondary "OPERATIONS". Left narrow vertical navigation occupying 20%: numbered entries "01 单机训练" (selected with small yellow edge), "02 联机对局", "03 靶场". Bottom left smaller entries "操作帮助" and "退出游戏". Main content from x=25% to 94%. Top right a wide local rectangular preview of a modest gray low-poly industrial training arena with concrete cover and subdued red/blue base accents; label "铸造场 / FOUNDRY", no photoreal AAA city, no new characters or narrative props. Beneath the preview, clear section "单机训练", secondary "本地对局". Two light-gray well-spaced setting cards in one row: "人机数量" with "-  4  +" and "人机难度" with "普通" and a discrete chevron. A thin text line "对局时长 05:00". Bottom right yellow strong action "开始训练" with black text and arrow. This is selected single-player setup: do not show IP, server list, gear stats, currencies, shop, missions, accounts, multiplayer matchmaking or news. Footer minimal "PC · 键鼠". Main UI fills screen with balanced negative space and asymmetric editorial clarity.

Screen: NORMAL IN-MATCH FIRST-PERSON COMBAT HUD. Environment occupies at least 85% of the image unobscured: a modest low-poly gray industrial training arena, concrete blocks, walkways and grounded geometric structures, soft daylight, one distant red training robot target. No giant dashboard panels. A simple low-poly held rifle with gloved hands in lower center-right is part of the GAME SCENE, distinct from the monochrome UI weapon icon. Center must remain clear: tiny precise white four-line crosshair, no interaction tooltip in this normal state. Compact top-center score strip, three equal zones: left "蓝队 12" with square blue marker, middle larger "03:42", right "红队 09" with triangle muted red marker. Team labels and shapes both distinguish meaning. Bottom left small dark translucent local backing: "生命", large "100", a thin white full HP bar, small label "蓝队". Bottom right small dark translucent local backing: a recognizable small flat light M4 silhouette, label "M4", large ammo "30" then clearly subordinate "/ 120". Small secondary hint "R 换弹". A short kill-feedback toast near upper right, not centered, "击倒确认 +1". DO NOT add minimap, teammate roster, quests, portrait, abilities, skill hotbar, armor, stamina, giant weapon name, full-screen scanlines, repeated keyboard help, extra score counters or boxes. Bare minimum yellow emphasis. Thin edge protections make text readable against the gray environment. The mood is quiet, crisp and battle-readable.

Screen: IN-GAME LOADOUT PANEL IN OWN BASE. The same modest low-poly gray industrial arena is visible around a large centered panel occupying approximately 80% width and 74% height; peripheral scene still recognizable with a held first-person weapon largely obscured by panel. No heavy full-screen blur. Panel charcoal outer shell. Header "本局配装", small secondary "LOADOUT", top-right outlined keycaps and label "P / Esc 关闭". A status line "基地内 · 可更换装备" with a small simple shield symbol. Panel left 58% contains TWO COLUMNS titled "主武器" and "副武器". Primary cards: "M4" (selected, yellow thin edge and explicit check label "已装备"), "AK", "MP5". Secondary cards: "M9" (explicit check label "已装备"), "重型手枪". All cards light warm-gray with dark type and flat black clean recognizable weapon silhouettes pointing consistently right. Remaining primary weapons represented by simple vertical scroll indicator, not fake extra models. Right 36% is a spacious charcoal detail region for the hovered/equipped M4: very large simple white M4 side silhouette pointing right, title "M4", category "主武器 / 步枪", small state badge "已装备". Use clean fine divider and two short readable rules: "点击武器立即选择" and "成功选择后，本局自动保存". Bottom status strip text "首次离开基地后，本次生命不能再次选枪". Smaller but still readable corner notice "对局仍在进行". No APPLY, SAVE, confirm, receive, buy, equip or collect buttons anywhere: clicking a weapon card itself is the action. No price, damage bars, invented stats, progressions or premium currencies. Do not gray out equipped cards: reselecting equipped weapons is allowed. Preserve generous readable spacing and clear dark/light separation.
